context:
When phax first drove Mistral Vibe, Vibe had no per-run way to choose a model or a thinking level. phax worked around that in three places.

Setup: `phax agent setup mistral-vibe --install-model-aliases` appends one `[[models]]` block per thinking level to the user's `~/.vibe/config.toml`. Each block is marked `# Added by PHAX.` and has the alias `phax-mistral-medium-3.5-off` or `phax-mistral-medium-3.5-high`. It copies the base alias `mistral-medium-3.5`'s name, provider, temperature, prices and auto_compact_threshold, and sets `thinking = "<level>"`. The command writes a backup and reports any `-low`/`-medium`/`-max` aliases an older phax left behind.

Catalog: the `mistral-vibe` provider entry carries `"modelEnvVar": "VIBE_ACTIVE_MODEL"`. Its `mistral-medium` family lists the two alias ids, one effort each. The equivalence table anchors `phax-mistral-medium-3.5-off`/off to `claude-haiku-4-5-20251001`/none and `phax-mistral-medium-3.5-high`/high to `claude-sonnet-4-6`/high. `RETIRED_MODEL_IDS` already holds the `-low`, `-medium` and `-max` aliases. phax refuses a `providers.json` that lists them, and `phax agent setup providers --write` drops them, together with any family they leave empty.

Invocation: every headless turn runs `vibe -p <prompt> --agent … --output streaming [--output-dir <dir>] --workdir … [--resume <id>]` and sets `VIBE_ACTIVE_MODEL=<alias>` in the environment. A sealed completion does the same. The fresh-start command a review stop prints runs Vibe's TUI: `cd '<worktree>' && VIBE_ACTIVE_MODEL='<alias>' 'vibe' '--workdir' '<worktree>' … '<prompt>'`. It is persisted as `{ cwd, argv, env }` in the stop record. After a confined turn, phax reads the export's `config` and compares it with the confinement it set: permissions, outside_workdir, MCP, tools and enabled_tools, but not the model. phax refuses a Vibe older than 3.0.3 before any session spawns, with `mistral-vibe <v> is installed; phax needs 3.0.3 or later.` and `Upgrade it: uv tool upgrade mistral-vibe`.

Mistral Vibe 3.1.3, installed 2026-11-18, adds what phax lacked. `--model ALIAS` selects a model for a new headless session without saving it, and an unknown alias is a usage error (exit 1). `--thinking LEVEL` selects the thinking level for a new headless session; a level that an agent profile or the admin config fixes is a usage error. Vibe's built-in table has the alias `mistral-medium-3.5`, with thinking levels off and high and a default of high. A resumed session keeps the model and agent it last ran. `--output-dir` still writes `export.json` at `schema_version: 1`, and its effective `config` includes `active_model`. phax's real-CLI Vibe e2e passes on 3.1.3 unchanged, on the alias path.

Vibe 3.1.3's own source, read on 2026-11-18 from the installed package (`vibe/app_server/`), shows where `--thinking` lands. In `_session_model.py`, `set_session_reasoning_effort_override` writes a session's thinking level as a patch at `model_thinking_path(alias)`, and `_config_paths.py` defines that path as `/models/<alias>/thinking`. The patch goes into the overrides layer, the same layer where `--model` writes `/active_model`. Agent-profile and admin layers outrank it, which is why a level they fix is a usage error. `run_export.py` describes the export's `config` as "the redacted config the session ran with, as the server resolved it". In `_config_introspect.py`, `redact_config` replaces header, environment and MCP argument values and strips URL user info and query strings, "keeping its shape"; it does not drop `models`. A 3.1.3 export should therefore carry the level beside `active_model`, as the `thinking` of the `models` entry for the alias that `active_model` names. This comes from the source only and has not yet been seen in a real export. The exact shape of `models` in the dumped config is not confirmed: it may be a table keyed by alias, or a list of entries that each carry `alias`.
problem:
phax edits a file it does not own. Before a Vibe phase can run, the user's `~/.vibe/config.toml` must carry blocks that phax wrote. phax copies prices and compaction thresholds into those blocks, and the copies drift as Vibe changes its own table. A user who never ran the installer gets a model alias Vibe does not know. A user who did run it keeps phax-shaped config in Vibe's home directory, with a backup file beside it. The catalog names models (`phax-mistral-medium-3.5-*`) that exist only because of the workaround. Each one needs equivalence edges, retirement entries and an installer to maintain.

Vibe now offers per-run `--model` and `--thinking` flags, so none of this machinery is needed. The model selection and the thinking level are also unchecked. A confined turn that ran under a model or a level other than the one phax chose is accepted, because the post-turn check never looks at `active_model` or at the thinking level. That can happen when an agent profile overrides it, or when a resumed session restores something else.

Removing the workaround has two traps. First, an existing `providers.json` lists only the two alias ids in its `mistral-medium` family, and today's rewrite drops a family that it empties. Second, a scaffolded `model-routing.json` keys its Vibe edges on those ids. Either way, Vibe would silently stop being routed.

productGoal.statement: phax chooses a Vibe session's model and thinking level per invocation, with Vibe's own `--model` and `--thinking` flags and Vibe's own `mistral-medium-3.5` alias. It never writes Vibe's config to make this work. It confirms afterwards that a confined turn ran under the model and the thinking level it asked for. The catalog, the version floor, the stop command and the setup commands change to match. An old `providers.json` or `model-routing.json` is refused by name and fixed by one documented step, never read leniently or ignored silently.
productGoal.guidingRule: phax picks a Vibe model only through what Vibe exposes per run (its flags and its own model table), and never through files in Vibe's home directory.

terminology.definition: A model name in Vibe's model table that Vibe resolves to a provider model. `mistral-medium-3.5` is a built-in Vibe alias. `phax-mistral-medium-3.5-off` and `phax-mistral-medium-3.5-high` are the aliases phax used to install.
The value Vibe's `--thinking` takes. For `mistral-medium-3.5` phax uses `off` and `high`, which are the catalog's efforts for that model.
A Vibe invocation with `-p` and without `--resume`: a phase's first turn, an authoring, code-review, compliance-review, decide or extraction session, or a sealed completion.
A headless Vibe invocation with `--resume <session-id>`, such as a fix-loop turn or a closing turn.
A headless Vibe turn that phax confines: a secure-mode session, or any read-only session. These are the only turns whose export phax compares with what it set.
The `# Added by PHAX.` `[[models]]` blocks that `phax agent setup mistral-vibe --install-model-aliases` appended to `~/.vibe/config.toml`.
A catalog id phax no longer routes to, listed with its reason. phax refuses a `providers.json` that lists one, and `phax agent setup providers --write` removes it.
The command a review stop prints, and records in its stop record, that starts a new interactive Vibe (TUI) session in the phase worktree.

requirements.title: New sessions carry model and thinking flags
requirements.statement: WHEN phax starts a new headless Vibe session THE system SHALL pass `--model <model>` and `--thinking <effort>`, where `<model>` is the catalog model and `<effort>` the effort that routing resolved for that session.

requirements.title: Resumed turns carry neither flag
requirements.statement: WHEN phax runs a resumed Vibe turn THE system SHALL pass neither `--model` nor `--thinking`.

requirements.title: No model variable on headless turns
requirements.statement: The system shall set no `VIBE_ACTIVE_MODEL` variable in the environment of any headless Vibe invocation.

requirements.title: A confined turn ran under the model phax chose
requirements.statement: IF a confined Vibe turn's export reports a `config.active_model` other than the model phax resolved for the session, on a new or a resumed turn THEN the system SHALL refuse the turn's result, naming `active_model`, the reported value, the value phax set and the export it read.

requirements.title: A confined turn ran at the thinking level phax chose
requirements.statement: IF a confined Vibe turn's export reports, for the alias `config.active_model` names, a thinking level other than the effort phax resolved for the session, or reports none, on a new or a resumed turn THEN the system SHALL refuse the turn's result, naming the thinking level, the reported value (or its absence), the value phax set and the export it read.

requirements.title: The mistral-medium family lists Vibe's own alias
requirements.statement: The system shall ship a `mistral-vibe` catalog whose `mistral-medium` family lists exactly one model, `mistral-medium-3.5`, with efforts `off` and `high`.

requirements.title: Equivalences move to the new id
requirements.statement: The system shall ship equivalence edges keyed on `mistral-medium-3.5`: `off` to `claude-haiku-4-5-20251001` at `none` and `high` to `claude-sonnet-4-6` at `high`, both `equivalent`, and none keyed on a `phax-mistral-medium-3.5-*` id.

requirements.title: The alias ids are retired
requirements.statement: IF `~/.phax/providers.json` lists `phax-mistral-medium-3.5-off` or `phax-mistral-medium-3.5-high` THEN the system SHALL refuse the file before any session spawns, naming each such id, why it is retired, and `phax agent setup providers --write`.

requirements.title: The rewrite lists the successor in place of the alias ids
requirements.statement: WHEN `phax agent setup providers --write` removes a retired `phax-mistral-medium-3.5-*` id from a family THE system SHALL list `mistral-medium-3.5` with efforts `off` and `high` in that family, once, unless the family already lists it.

requirements.title: `modelEnvVar` is refused by name
requirements.statement: IF a provider entry in `~/.phax/providers.json` carries `modelEnvVar` THEN the system SHALL refuse the file, naming the field's path and `phax agent setup providers --write`.

requirements.title: The rewrite drops `modelEnvVar`
requirements.statement: WHEN `phax agent setup providers --write` reads a `providers.json` whose entries carry `modelEnvVar` THE system SHALL write the file back without that field and report each field it dropped.

requirements.title: Routing edges on retired ids are refused
requirements.statement: IF `~/.phax/model-routing.json` keys an equivalence on a retired id THEN the system SHALL refuse the file, naming each such id and, for a `phax-mistral-medium-3.5-*` id, `mistral-medium-3.5` as the key to use instead.

requirements.title: Version floor 3.1.3
requirements.statement: IF the installed `vibe` reports a version older than 3.1.3 THEN the system SHALL refuse before any Vibe session spawns, naming the installed version, 3.1.3 and `uv tool upgrade mistral-vibe`.

requirements.title: phax never writes Vibe's config
requirements.statement: The system shall never write, back up or append to any file under Vibe's home directory (`~/.vibe` or `$VIBE_HOME`), and shall never read it to choose a model or a thinking level.

requirements.title: The alias installer is gone
requirements.statement: The system shall offer no `phax agent setup mistral-vibe` command, so that invoking it fails as an unknown command and `phax agent setup` lists only its remaining subcommands.

requirements.title: The fresh-start command names the model by variable
requirements.statement: WHEN a review stop of a Vibe phase builds its fresh-start command THE system SHALL set `VIBE_ACTIVE_MODEL` to the phase's catalog model (`mistral-medium-3.5`) in that command's environment and pass neither `--model` nor `--thinking`.

requirements.title: The stop says the TUI ignores the phase's level
requirements.statement: WHEN a review stop of a Vibe phase prints its fresh-start command THE system SHALL print beside it that the interactive session starts at the model's default thinking level, naming the phase's resolved level.

requirements.title: Records name the new model id
requirements.statement: The system shall record `mistral-medium-3.5` as the model of every Vibe run, phase and authoring record written from now on, and shall read records that name a `phax-mistral-medium-3.5-*` id unchanged.

surface.summary: The upgrade notes tell a Vibe user the three steps to take: upgrade Vibe, rewrite providers.json, and optionally delete the PHAX alias blocks.
surface.after:
### 0.41.0

- **phax picks the Vibe model with `--model` and `--thinking`, and needs mistral-vibe 3.1.3.** Run `uv tool upgrade mistral-vibe`.
- **Run `phax agent setup providers --write` once.** It lists `mistral-medium-3.5` in place of `phax-mistral-medium-3.5-off` and `-high` and drops `modelEnvVar`; phax refuses the old file until you do.
- **A `model-routing.json` keyed on the old ids is refused.** Rename each key to `mistral-medium-3.5`, keeping its edges.
- **`phax agent setup mistral-vibe` is gone, and phax no longer reads `~/.vibe/config.toml`.** The `# Added by PHAX.` blocks still work in your own Vibe sessions. To remove them, delete each comment line and the `[[models]]` table under it.
- Run, phase and authoring records written before keep the old model ids.

nonGoals: Mistral Large 4 (`mistral-large-4-0`), any other Vibe model or family, and re-pointing routing defaults by cost.
Vibe's `--time-limit`, `--max-tokens` and `--max-price` flags, and the export's `warnings` (denied tool calls).
Editing or deleting the user's PHAX alias blocks: phax neither removes them nor reports them. The upgrade notes say how to delete them by hand.
Interactive resume for Vibe, and any `--model`/`--thinking` support in Vibe's TUI.
Changing the secure-mode confinement: `--agent accept-edits`, the `VIBE_*` variables, `VIBE_TOOLS` and the existing refusals stay as they are.
Checking a requested thinking level against Vibe's model table. A level an agent profile or the admin config fixes is Vibe's own usage error.
Rewriting records written before this change, or any change to a persisted format (run, phase, authoring, cost history, stop record).
Comparing the model of an unconfined (unsafe) Vibe turn, which phax does not read back today either.
Scaffolding or rewriting `model-routing.json` for the user: `--with-routing` still never overwrites.

acceptanceCriteria.name: A phase's first turn picks model and level by flag
acceptanceCriteria.given: a secure Vibe phase that routing resolved to `mistral-medium-3.5` at effort `high`
acceptanceCriteria.then: the argv contains `--model mistral-medium-3.5` and `--thinking high`, and the spawned environment has no `VIBE_ACTIVE_MODEL`

acceptanceCriteria.name: Every new-session kind carries the flags
acceptanceCriteria.given: an authoring session, a code-review session, a compliance-review session, a decide session, an extraction session and a sealed completion, each routed to Vibe at `mistral-medium-3.5`/`off`
acceptanceCriteria.then: each argv contains `--model mistral-medium-3.5 --thinking off`, and no spawned environment has `VIBE_ACTIVE_MODEL`

acceptanceCriteria.name: A resumed turn carries neither flag
acceptanceCriteria.given: a Vibe phase whose session `S` ran its first turn
acceptanceCriteria.then: the argv contains `--resume S` and neither `--model` nor `--thinking`, and the environment has no `VIBE_ACTIVE_MODEL`

acceptanceCriteria.name: A turn under another model is refused
acceptanceCriteria.given: a confined Vibe turn for which phax resolved `mistral-medium-3.5` and whose `export.json` reports `config.active_model` `"mistral-large-4-0"`
acceptanceCriteria.then: its result is refused, the message names `active_model`, `"mistral-large-4-0"`, `"mistral-medium-3.5"` and the export path, and the phase records no answer from that turn

acceptanceCriteria.name: A turn under the chosen model is accepted
acceptanceCriteria.given: a confined resumed Vibe turn whose `export.json` reports `config.active_model` `"mistral-medium-3.5"`, the model phax resolved for the session, and the thinking level phax resolved for it
acceptanceCriteria.when: the turn ends with an answer
acceptanceCriteria.then: the answer is accepted

acceptanceCriteria.name: A turn at another thinking level is refused
acceptanceCriteria.given: a confined Vibe turn for which phax resolved `mistral-medium-3.5` at effort `off` and whose `export.json` reports `config.active_model` `"mistral-medium-3.5"` with a thinking level `"high"` for that alias
acceptanceCriteria.then: its result is refused, the message names the thinking level, `"high"`, `"off"` and the export path, and the phase records no answer from that turn

acceptanceCriteria.name: A turn whose export holds no thinking level is refused
acceptanceCriteria.given: a confined Vibe turn whose `export.json` reports `config.active_model` `"mistral-medium-3.5"` and no thinking level for that alias
acceptanceCriteria.then: its result is refused, the message names the thinking level as absent, the value phax set and the export path

acceptanceCriteria.name: Real Vibe runs both levels without PHAX aliases
acceptanceCriteria.given: Mistral Vibe 3.1.3 with `MISTRAL_API_KEY` set and a `VIBE_HOME` whose `config.toml` holds no PHAX alias blocks
acceptanceCriteria.when: phax runs one secure session at `mistral-medium-3.5`/`off` and one at `mistral-medium-3.5`/`high`
acceptanceCriteria.then: both complete, each `export.json` reports `config.active_model` `"mistral-medium-3.5"` and the thinking level `"off"` or `"high"` that phax set, and the `config.toml` bytes are unchanged

acceptanceCriteria.name: Real Vibe resume keeps the model
acceptanceCriteria.given: a real Vibe 3.1.3 session that phax started at `mistral-medium-3.5`/`high`
acceptanceCriteria.when: phax resumes it with `--resume` and neither flag
acceptanceCriteria.then: the resumed turn's `export.json` reports `config.active_model` `"mistral-medium-3.5"` and the thinking level `"high"`, and phax accepts the turn

acceptanceCriteria.name: An older Vibe is refused before spawning
acceptanceCriteria.given: a `vibe` executable that prints `vibe 3.1.2` for `--version`
acceptanceCriteria.when: phax is about to start any Vibe session
acceptanceCriteria.then: it refuses with `mistral-vibe 3.1.2 is installed; phax needs 3.1.3 or later.` and `Upgrade it: uv tool upgrade mistral-vibe`, and no session process is spawned

acceptanceCriteria.name: Claude requests reach the new id
acceptanceCriteria.given: no `~/.phax/providers.json` or `~/.phax/model-routing.json` and `mistral-vibe` first in provider priority and enabled
acceptanceCriteria.when: phax resolves a `claude-sonnet-4-6`/`high` request and a `claude-haiku-4-5-20251001`/`none` request
acceptanceCriteria.then: they resolve to `mistral-vibe`, `mistral-medium-3.5` at `high` and at `off`, both `equivalent`, and the built-in `mistral-medium` family lists exactly `mistral-medium-3.5` with efforts `off`, `high`

acceptanceCriteria.name: A providers.json with the alias ids is refused
acceptanceCriteria.given: a `~/.phax/providers.json` without `modelEnvVar` whose `mistral-medium` family lists `phax-mistral-medium-3.5-off` and `phax-mistral-medium-3.5-high`
acceptanceCriteria.then: it refuses before any session spawns, naming both ids and `phax agent setup providers --write`

acceptanceCriteria.name: The rewrite lists mistral-medium-3.5 in their place
acceptanceCriteria.given: that same `providers.json`
acceptanceCriteria.then: the rewritten `mistral-medium` family lists exactly `{ "id": "mistral-medium-3.5", "efforts": ["off", "high"], "status": "active" }`, the output names both dropped ids and `mistral-medium-3.5`, and a backup of the old file exists

acceptanceCriteria.name: A providers.json with modelEnvVar is refused by name
acceptanceCriteria.given: a `~/.phax/providers.json` whose `mistral-vibe` entry carries `"modelEnvVar": "VIBE_ACTIVE_MODEL"`
acceptanceCriteria.then: it refuses, naming `providers.mistral-vibe.modelEnvVar` and `phax agent setup providers --write`

acceptanceCriteria.name: One rewrite fixes a pre-upgrade providers.json
acceptanceCriteria.given: a `~/.phax/providers.json` as an older phax wrote it, with `modelEnvVar` and the two alias ids
acceptanceCriteria.when: `phax agent setup providers --write` runs and then `phax run` loads the file
acceptanceCriteria.then: the rewritten file has no `modelEnvVar` and lists `mistral-medium-3.5`, the output names the dropped field, and the load succeeds

acceptanceCriteria.name: A routing table keyed on an alias id is refused
acceptanceCriteria.given: a `~/.phax/model-routing.json` whose `equivalence` has a key `phax-mistral-medium-3.5-high`
acceptanceCriteria.then: it refuses, naming `phax-mistral-medium-3.5-high` and `mistral-medium-3.5`

acceptanceCriteria.name: A Vibe run leaves Vibe's home untouched
acceptanceCriteria.given: a `VIBE_HOME` holding a `config.toml`, with or without PHAX alias blocks
acceptanceCriteria.when: phax runs a Vibe phase to its review stop
acceptanceCriteria.then: no file under `VIBE_HOME` was created or modified, and no `*.phax-backup-*` file exists there

acceptanceCriteria.name: The alias installer is gone
acceptanceCriteria.given: this release of phax
acceptanceCriteria.then: it exits non-zero as an unknown command, and `phax agent setup --help` lists no `mistral-vibe` subcommand

acceptanceCriteria.name: The fresh start names mistral-medium-3.5 by variable
acceptanceCriteria.given: a Vibe phase at `mistral-medium-3.5`/`off` that reaches a review stop
acceptanceCriteria.when: the stop prints and records its fresh-start command
acceptanceCriteria.then: the command's environment is `{ "VIBE_ACTIVE_MODEL": "mistral-medium-3.5" }`, and its argv contains neither `--model` nor `--thinking`

acceptanceCriteria.name: The stop warns the TUI ignores the phase's level
acceptanceCriteria.given: the same stop
acceptanceCriteria.then: next to the fresh-start command they say the interactive session starts at the model's default thinking level and name the phase's level `off`, and the stop record's command keeps exactly the fields `cwd`, `argv`, `env`

acceptanceCriteria.name: New records name the new id; old ones still read
acceptanceCriteria.given: a run recorded before this change whose phase names `phax-mistral-medium-3.5-high`, and a new run that completes a Vibe phase
acceptanceCriteria.when: phax reads both runs' records and their cost history
acceptanceCriteria.then: the new phase record names `mistral-medium-3.5`, the old one still reads `phax-mistral-medium-3.5-high` without error, and the cost history sums both

openQuestions.question: What happens to `phax agent setup mistral-vibe`?

options.label: Remove the command; the upgrade notes say how to delete the PHAX alias blocks by hand
options.abandons: Any in-product signal to a user who still has PHAX alias blocks in their Vibe config that phax no longer uses them

options.label: Keep it as a read-only report of leftover PHAX alias blocks
options.abandons: The guiding rule that phax never reads Vibe's home: a phax command keeps parsing `~/.vibe/config.toml` only to tell users about blocks that still work and harm nothing

options.label: Turn it into a remover of the PHAX alias blocks
options.abandons: The promise that phax never writes Vibe's config: phax would edit the user's file once more, with backup and parsing risk, for blocks the user may now rely on in their own sessions

openQuestions.rationale: The leftover blocks are harmless: they still work in the user's own Vibe sessions and phax ignores them. The lost signal is therefore cheap, and one upgrade-notes entry replaces it. Both alternatives keep phax in Vibe's home directory, which is exactly what this change exists to end.

openQuestions.question: What does the interactive fresh-start command carry, given that Vibe's TUI takes neither `--model` nor `--thinking`?

options.label: Keep `VIBE_ACTIVE_MODEL=mistral-medium-3.5` in the command, and print a note that the thinking level is the model's default, naming the phase's level
options.abandons: A headless-path purity: one place still selects the model through an environment variable, and a phase at `off` reopens interactively at Vibe's default level

options.label: Print the command with no model at all
options.abandons: Model continuity: the person reviewing lands on Vibe's default model, now `mistral-large-4-0`, which is a different model, price and behaviour from the phase they are reviewing

openQuestions.rationale: Reviewing a phase on a different model than the one that wrote it is the worse loss, and it is silent. A thinking-level mismatch is named in the note, and the person can change it in the TUI. `VIBE_ACTIVE_MODEL` is Vibe's documented override, not a phax alias, so keeping it costs nothing in Vibe's home.

openQuestions.question: Does `modelEnvVar` stay in the provider entry schema?

options.label: Drop the field: an old file carrying it is refused by name and `phax agent setup providers --write` rewrites it
options.abandons: Configurability of the TUI's model variable name: if Vibe renamed `VIBE_ACTIVE_MODEL`, the fix would be a phax release, not a config edit

options.label: Keep the field, used only by the fresh-start command
options.abandons: A config surface that means what it says: a field named for model selection that the headless path ignores, kept for one interactive command, on Vibe only

openQuestions.rationale: Vibe was the field's only user, and the variable is Vibe's own documented name, so the fresh-start command can name it itself. A Vibe rename would need a phax release anyway, for the flags. Dropping it follows the no-shim policy: the old file is refused and rewritten by the existing command.

openQuestions.question: When `phax agent setup providers --write` drops the two alias ids, does it list `mistral-medium-3.5` in their place?

options.label: List `mistral-medium-3.5` (off, high) in the family the alias ids leave
options.abandons: The rewrite's narrow role of only removing what phax retired: it now also adds a catalog entry the user did not write

options.label: Only drop them, as for the earlier retired aliases
options.abandons: Vibe routing for every upgraded user: their `mistral-medium` family empties and is dropped, so Vibe is never chosen again until they hand-edit the file, with nothing telling them so

openQuestions.rationale: Dropping only turns the one documented fix into a silent loss of the provider. The added entry is exactly the built-in one, so the user ends up with what a fresh install would have.

openQuestions.question: What does phax do with a `model-routing.json` whose equivalence is keyed on a retired id?

options.label: Refuse it, naming each id and `mistral-medium-3.5` as the key to use
options.abandons: Uninterrupted runs for a user whose table also carries edges for the earlier retired `-low`/`-medium`/`-max` ids, which were harmless until now

options.label: Leave it as is: edges on ids that are not in the catalog are never selected
options.abandons: Vibe routing for any user with a scaffolded routing table: no edge points at `mistral-medium-3.5`, so hub-to-spoke never picks Vibe, and nothing says why

openQuestions.rationale: A silent loss of a provider is the failure this change must not introduce, and the refusal names its own fix. Edges on the earlier retired ids were dead weight, so refusing them costs one rename or deletion.

arbitratedQuestions.question: After a confined turn, does phax compare the thinking level as well as the model?

options.label: Compare `config.active_model` only; trust `--thinking` and Vibe's own refusal of a profile-fixed level
options.abandons: Detection of a turn that ran at a level phax did not ask for without Vibe refusing it, for example a resumed session that restored another level

options.label: Also compare the thinking level, from the export field that records it
options.abandons: A contract pinned on a field nobody has seen: no export read for this spec shows a thinking level, so the plan would have to find the field and might find there is none

arbitratedQuestions.rationale: A level fixed by a profile or by the admin config already makes Vibe exit with a usage error, so the silent case is narrow. The model is the costly and visible substitution, and `active_model` is known to be in the export. If a real 3.1.3 export does show the level, a later change can add the comparison against a field it has seen.

verdict.why: Vibe 3.1.3's source puts the level at /models/<alias>/thinking in the overrides layer, and the export's config is the whole resolved config with only credentials redacted (§1). So the field the recommendation feared nobody had seen should sit beside active_model, and comparing it costs the same as comparing the model. The plan confirms the shape of config.models on a real 3.1.3 export first.
verdict.advocate: The strongest case for model-only: the thinking level's place in the export is known from source only, so a contract pinned on it may rest on a field that is shaped differently or absent, and a profile-fixed level already makes Vibe refuse, leaving the silent case narrow.

settled: New headless Vibe sessions pass `--model <model> --thinking <effort>`. Resumed turns pass neither, and Vibe keeps the session's model and level.

phax never writes `~/.vibe/config.toml`: the alias installer goes, with its backup, its retired-alias report and its JSON answer fields (`installModelAliases`, `aliasesAdded`, `aliasesSkipped`, `aliasesRetired`, `backupPath`).

The `mistral-medium` family lists one model, `mistral-medium-3.5`, with efforts `off` and `high`. `phax-mistral-medium-3.5-off` and `-high` join `RETIRED_MODEL_IDS`, and the equivalence edges move to the new id, edge for edge.
The Vibe version floor is 3.1.3, enforced before any session spawns, like the 3.0.3 floor today.
Mistral Large 4 is a separate change.

The requirements follow each open question's recommendation, except q-thinking-check, decided as model-and-level: after a confined turn phax compares the thinking level of the active alias as well as the model. A different decision on another question revises the matching requirement and criterion.
open: Where `--model`/`--thinking` sit in the argv. Tests check presence and values, not position.
The final wording of the refusals, the setup output and the fresh-start note, and the JSON field names `setup providers --json` adds for replaced ids and dropped fields.

Before relying on it, confirm on a real 3.1.3 export the shape of `config.models` (a table keyed by alias, or a list of entries that carry `alias`) and the field holding the thinking level for the alias `config.active_model` names.
The release number of the upgrade entry. 0.41.0 assumes this ships in the next release after 0.40.0.
constraints: No back-compat shims. An old `providers.json` or `model-routing.json` is refused and fixed by the existing setup command or by hand, never read leniently. Only `phax agent setup providers` may read the old `providers.json` shape, and only to rewrite it.

phax never reads Vibe's home directory to choose a model. The flags, Vibe's own table and the export are the whole contract. The existing `accept-edits.toml` override check is confinement, not model choice, and stays.

The secure-mode confinement is unchanged: `--agent accept-edits`, the `VIBE_*` variables, `VIBE_TOOLS` and the refusals. The model and thinking-level checks join the existing post-turn comparison and keep its scope: confined turns only.

Before relying on it, verify on a real 3.1.3 export that `config.active_model` holds the alias passed to `--model`, including with Mistral's model catalog on, and confirm the shape of `config.models` and the level field before the level comparison is built on it.
The persisted stop command stays `{ cwd, argv, env }`. The fresh-start note is printed text only.
The real-CLI e2e (`tests/e2e/vibeSecure.test.ts`) moves off the alias path. It covers `off`, `high`, a resumed turn and a `VIBE_HOME` without PHAX blocks; the `MISTRAL_API_KEY` case stays skippable.

Docs to update: `docs/model-catalog.md` (catalog entry and a change-log line), `docs/model-routing.md` (examples, providers entry, Vibe setup steps), the README's Vibe setup (drop the installer line, add the 3.1.3 floor) and a `docs/upgrading.md` entry. Earlier upgrade entries that mention the installer stay as history.

docsPage.page: docs/model-routing.md, its Mistral Vibe setup section
docsPage.reader: An operator turning on Mistral Vibe for phax, or upgrading a setup that used the PHAX alias blocks
docsPage.example:
uv tool upgrade mistral-vibe          # phax needs 3.1.3 or later
phax agent setup providers --write    # enables vibe; lists mistral-medium-3.5, drops modelEnvVar and the old alias ids

# phax then runs each new Vibe session as:
vibe -p '<prompt>' --agent accept-edits --model mistral-medium-3.5 --thinking high --output streaming …
# and nothing in ~/.vibe/config.toml is needed or touched.
